statement: Employers must report each newly hired employee to the State Directory of New Hires of the state where the employee works, not later than 20 days after the date of hire, or by two monthly electronic transmissions 12 to 16 days apart (42 U.S.C. § 653a(b)(1)(A), (b)(2)(A)).
caveat: States may impose shorter deadlines and additional elements; multistate employers may designate a single reporting state. This repo does not file reports.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (law-map 2026-10-14); independent domain expert review pending
